tasks.completion_summary: Leak-hunt on the reused local RPC.Host. TWO root-cause signals. (1) Connection/session path is CLEAN: ClientRegistry.Remove runs in WebSocketConnectionHandler's finally and the per-client heartbeat loop exits on socket close; new stress test SessionLeakStressTests opens+aborts 200 WebSocket sessions and asserts the new server-side GameServer.ClientCount returns to baseline 0 -> no unbounded connection/session leak. (2) GENUINE per-frame growth leak FOUND+FIXED: StatePresenter.CreateStateMessage serialized the ENTIRE GameState.ActionLog into every state snapshot. ActionLog grows for a campaign's life (only cleared on reset_game) and the host is reused across many e2e runs locally, so each 'ready'/state-change frame's serialization cost grew O(accumulated-commands) and was fan-broadcast to all clients -- matching the reported 'per-test time balloons after many runs' symptom (code even had a dormant 1000-entry log-rotation warning, evidencing known unbounded growth). FIX: cap the snapshot's serialized actionLog to the most recent 200 entries (StatePresenter.SnapshotActionLogLimit) via a recent-tail Skip; stored ActionLog untouched so engine logic/tests are unaffected, and the client only consumes entries newer than its last-seen turn so a recent tail suffices. The 'host degrades after hours' note from iter20 is a separate compounding WSL2 GC/RSS factor; addressed deterministically by a host-restart harness: src/client/scripts/e2e-fresh.sh kills any stale RPC.Host (by :19421 and process name) before invoking Playwright on a fresh backend, wired as npm scripts test:e2e and test:e2e:fresh. Repo hygiene: git rm -r --cached src/client/test-results (already covered by root .gitignore 'test-results/'). VERIFICATION (fresh this turn): dotnet build clean (0 warn/0 err); full engine dotnet test 1225/1225 passed incl new SessionLeakStressTests + StatePresenterTests cap test; client npm run check exit 0; harness bash -n OK; package.json valid JSON. Changes left unstaged (the test-results untrack is necessarily staged as a deletion).

Debugged the 8 flaky e2e failures (branch-choice x3, downtime x3, faction-patrol x2). ROOT CAUSE: their shared loadTown() waited for .town-menu to render from the LIVE backend's pushed mode before injecting test state, but the dotnet host is shared and reused locally (reuseExistingServer). When a prior test/run left the backend in Combat/Exploration, mode!=Menu so .town-menu never appeared and the specs failed — proven by 3/3 isolation failure on the dirty backend. game.spec avoids this by sending reset_game first. FIX: added e2e/townHarness.ts with a deterministic loadTown() that injects a minimal Menu state via __testSetState (engages the store override gate, fully isolating from backend mode); the 3 specs now import it. Resolves the iter18(green)/iter19(8-fail) contradiction: iter18 ran on a fresh Menu backend, iter19 on a reused dirty one. Also de-flaked map-combat:152 (real combat) whose enter_combat->Combat wait used the 10s default vs the file's 20s convention; aligned to 20000ms, 4/4 green after. RESULTS: 8/8 target specs green in isolation; full suite 39/39 green on final-A AND on a fresh-backend run (8.9m normal speed). SPLIT OUT: a separate run (final-B) showed keybindings:47 + map-combat:50 fail with ballooned 46-60s durations after hours of continuous backend reuse — pure host resource degradation (neither touched by this change; both green on fresh host). Filed follow-up for e2e backend-reuse degradation. check 0 errors, build clean, 16/16 unit tests pass. Changes left unstaged.

Enforced unidirectional client action dispatch. Added pure intent->action adapter src/client/src/shared/actions/uiIntent.ts (UiIntent union + intentToAction) with 16 vitest unit tests (uiIntent.test.ts); installed vitest + added test:unit script + vite test config. Converted the three presentation components that bypassed the dispatch path: CombatOverlay (removed direct sendAction for UseAbility; now emits combatAbility/combatAction/flee intents via onIntent, dropped onCombatAction/onFlee props), TownMenu (rest/verifyRumor/branchChoose/transferTo/FromCache via onIntent), TownServicesPanel (downtime/verifyRumor/wildcardAlliance/resurrect via onIntent). App.svelte added single dispatchIntent(intent)=>sendAction(intentToAction(intent)); routed combat + cache + town recruit/mission/vendor handlers through it; removed dead handleCombatAction/handleFlee. grep confirms zero sendAction/gameStore imports remain in src/client/src/features/. npm run check 0 errors, build clean, 16/16 unit tests pass. e2e: 31 passed / 8 failed (branch-choice x3, downtime x3, faction-patrol x2) — PROVEN PRE-EXISTING via git stash: identical 8-failure set on clean HEAD with my changes stashed, so behavior preserved, no regression. NOTE: dispatch expected 39-green baseline but actual current-branch baseline is 31-green; pre-existing 8 failures warrant a separate investigation task.

Fixed 7 pre-existing e2e failures, root-caused to two prior refactors. (1) display-settings x3: accessibility section reused FOV/display CSS classes (fov-slider, display-value, display-select), causing strict-mode ambiguity. Product fix: gave Text Size slider/value and Colorblind select distinct classes (slider/a11y-value/a11y-select) with shared styling preserved via grouped selectors; FOV/Resolution selectors now unique. (2) downtime x3 + branch-choice modal-block x1: commit d377084 broadsheet refactor swapped PartyPanel->PartyBroadsheet and dropped TownServicesPanel from the party tab, orphaning the downtime UI (dead activeTab==='tavern' block) and .character-card. Product fix: re-gated downtime on activeTab='downtime' and mounted TownServicesPanel activeTab='downtime' on the party tab, restoring the reachable feature without duplicating tavern content. Test fix (justified): branch-choice modal-block test updated stale .character-card -> .rail-row (PartyBroadsheet roster). check 0 errors, build clean, full e2e 39 passed 0 failed.

Split App.svelte god component into client shell controllers. Extracted movement/input buffering to MovementInputController + resolveKeyToAction ($shared/input/movementInput.ts); action-log feedback/journal (rep toasts, faction notifications, synergy discovery/reveal, localStorage persistence, synergy chime) to self-subscribing createActionLogFeedback store ($shared/stores/actionLogFeedback.ts); renderer + ambient/unaccounted audio + subtitle lifecycle to RendererHost service ($renderer/RendererHost.ts). App.svelte script reduced 539->328 lines, now primarily composes mode views + overlays + bootstrap/event wiring. Behavior preserved verbatim. npm run check 0 errors, npm run build clean. e2e: 13 core specs pass (movement, keyboard, dungeon, websocket, keybindings, subtitles); 7 pre-existing failures (display-settings/downtime/branch-choice) verified identical on stashed baseline — unrelated to this refactor.

Routed dungeon generation through content-defined templates. Added DungeonContentSet (RPC.Engine) owning template validation (segment ids, encounter table, display name, watcher path), watcher-path derivation, and directory->template mapping — outside GameServer. Added segmentDirectory to DungeonTemplate + all 11 template JSONs. GameServer now watches every content-defined segment directory (not hard-coded broken-engine) and ReloadSegments reports affected dungeon/template via BroadcastContentReload(affectedDungeons). ContentBootstrap validates fail-fast at load. 8 new tests incl. two-dungeon-type distinct routing. dotnet test: 1223 passed.

Fixed CharacterSheet modal a11y: replaced non-functional panel-focused Escape handler (tabindex=-1, never focused) with codebase-standard <svelte:window onkeydown> Escape-to-close, matching FieldNotesPanel/SettingsPanel; backdrop keeps role=presentation + real close button. npm run check: 0 warnings; build passes.
